listing.summary: Fork of <@259007154286100481>'s Experimental Hull Modifications, compatible with 0.98a. Fixed by <@142592906178330624> and pantsmode.
listing.aiSummary: Provides extreme ship customization through hull modifications, slot shunts, and system swaps without prioritizing balance.

description: Offers a wide range of hull modifications including shield and engine customization, system changes, and slot type alterations. Includes categories for systems, retrofits, cosmetics, activators, and various slot shunts like adapters and converters. The mod focuses on extreme customization rather than game balance.
